text:
[IRET.4.5] `justif_count` is non-zero only for
`logical`-scoped facts. When it reaches zero the fact is
retracted by the TMS path.

---

idris.name: iret_12_2__zeroed
idris.note: The facts whose count reached zero when their activation ended; only those are retracted, so a never-justified input fact is left alone.
